jobs_results.title: Java Developer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

Find your place at Amaris Consulting in a new project as a Java Developer working in Spain (Remotely). Become part of an international team, thrive in a global group with €800M turnover and 1,000+ clients worldwide, andan agile environment by identifying, collaborating and developing software optimization. Join Amaris Consulting, where you can develop your potential and make a difference within the company.

✍️ WHAT WOULD YOU NEED? ✍️
• 4-6 Years of Experience
• Expert in Java 8, 11
• Microservices
• Springboot
• Docker
• Kafka
• Kubernetes
• Testing experience with Junit or Mockito.
• JPA, Oracle, JDBC.
• English Fluent

👉 WHAT WILL YOU DO? 👈
• Develop and maintain business applications using the Java programming language.Collaborate with other developers, designers, and technology specialists to identify and solve problems and optimize software quality.
• Work with databases to design and develop schemas, write queries, and optimize application performance.
•... Write clean and efficient code that is easy to maintain and extend.
• Perform unit and integration testing to ensure the software is stable and meets client requirements.
• Participate in the software design process and make informed technical decisions to ensure software scalability and efficiency.
• Document code and functionalities to ensure that other team members can understand and work with the code effectively.
• Stay up-to-date on the latest trends and technologies in the field of software development and apply them in daily work.
• Identify and propose improvements in development processes and methodologies to increase software efficiency and quality.
• Be an active and collaborative member of the software development team, contributing ideas, providing feedback, and participating in the decision-making process.

🚀 WHY US? 🚀

Join our dynamic team of talented individuals and experience a world of growth and opportunities. Here's what we offer:
• Grow rapidly with a tailored career path and salary evaluation. 70% of our senior leaders started at entry level.
• Enhance your skills through our Tech Academy catalog, Udemy E-learning Platform, Languages Sessions, webinars, and workshops.
• Take charge of your training with an annual personal budget and company-paid certifications.
• Enjoy flexible policies, remote work options, and fantastic social benefits like transit and restaurant tickets, kindergarten support, and private health insurance.
• Benefit from our WeCare program, supporting employees in critical situations.
• Unleash your full potential, both professionally and personally

Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics

jobs_results.title: Java Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are a digitally native technology services company where innovation, design and engineering meet scale. We use some of the latest technologies in the digital and cognitive field to empower organizations in every aspect.

Right now, we are looking for Java Developers to join our team at Globant!

You will get the chance to:
• Work with professionals who have created some of the most revolutionary solutions in their fields.
• Make an impact. Work in large-scale projects globally.
• Develop your career in our Studios. Each Studio represents deep pockets of expertise on the latest technologies and trends and delivers tailored solutions focused on specific challenges.
• Develop your career within an industry or multiple industries.
• Work in the city you want, and be nourished by cultural exchanges.
• Be empowered to choose your career path: we have more than 600 simultaneous projects, so you can choose where and how to work.
• Be part of an agile pod. Driven by a culture of... self-regulated teamwork, each team -or
• POD- works directly with our customers with a full maturity path that evolves as they increase speed, quality and autonomy.

What will help you succeed:
• Believe and love what you do.
• Have imagination and love innovating.
• Being flexible & goal oriented.
• Being capable of taking a step back to look at a bigger picture.
• Fluent English skills.
• Proven hands-on Software Development experience working with the last versions of Java as the main programming language and familiarity using functionalities like Lambdas and Java Streams.
• Object Oriented analysis and design using common design patterns.
• Knowledge of Relational Databases (Oracle, Postgres, some ORM is a plus)
• Experience working with Spring Framework
• Microservices architecture. (use of containers is a plus)
• Understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git.
• Familiarity with build tools such as Maven or Gradle.
• Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery development processes using tools like jenkins.
• Familiarity with cloud technologies and platforms (AWS is a plus).

Are you ready?

At Globant we believe that an inclusive culture and a diverse environment makes us stronger. We encourage people to have an inclusive spirit as our global footprint expands. We seek to generate a place of inspiration and growth for everyone. A safe space, based on equity as a value, where everyone's careers can be promoted and developed in the same way. There is no innovation without diversity and there is no improvement without plurality.

Job Segment: Developer, Java, Cloud, Database, Oracle, Technology

Un desarrollador Android/Java orientado principalmente al desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles nativas y aplicaciones de backend.

Trabajará creando aplicaciones móviles para profesionales y centrales críticas de sincronización para empresas de diversos sectores enlazando con distintas plataformas y sistemas finales de clientes.

Capacidades clave:
• Amplios conocimientos de Android
• Conocimientos Java 7/8, J2EE
• Experiencia en Eclipse, Android Studio, Gradle, Maven, Ant
• Experiencia real con Base de datos: SQL, Bases de Datos relacionales (MySQL, PostgreSQL), SQLite, JPA, Hibernate
• Fuertes conocimientos de web services : JSON, Soap, Servicios RESTful
• Conocimientos de instalación, mantenimiento y configuración de servidores de aplicaciones Tomcat y bases de datos MySQL
• Experiencia de Programación orientada a objetos, modelización, …
• Experiencia en Análisis / Diseño / Implementación / Pruebas
• Experiencia en proyectos reales empleando... sistemas de control de versiones: SVN y git
• Framework : MVC, preferiblemente Struts 2.0

• Conocimientos de IOS (XCode, APN, …) y aplicaciones móviles híbridas (Ionic)
• Conocimientos de Protocolos de aplicación (HTTP, SSH, FTP, DNS), transporte (TCP, UDP), etc…
• Conocimientos de Métodos de HTTP (GET, POST, DELE.
• Amplios conocimientos de Android
• Experiencia en Eclipse, Android Studio, Gradle, Maven, Ant
• Java y Android SDK
• Programación orientada a objetos, modelización, …

• Fuertes conocimientos de web services y comunicación : json-rcp, xml-rpc, Soap, Servicios RESTful
• Conocimientos de Análisis / Diseño / Implementación
• Protocolos de aplicación (HTTP, SSH, FTP, DNS), transporte (TCP, UDP), etc…
• Métodos de HTTP (GET, POST, DELETE, …)
• Formatos ligeros como JSON, lenguaje de marcas XML, protocolo SOAP, …
• Sistemas de control de versiones: SVN, git
• Conocimientos de IOS (XCode, APN, …) y aplicaciones móviles híbridas (Ionic)
• Capacidades de comunicación con desarrolladores y clientes.

Otros beneficios de trabajar en KERNET:

Horario flexible todo el año y jornada intensiva en verano y todos los viernes del año.

Formación interna contínua y gratuita.

Vacaciones flexibles solicitables por días sueltos.

Abono del 100% del salario durante las bajas por enfermedad
